title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E4 — How Slowly They Forget
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E8 — Don Adams, Roscoe Lee Browne, The Staple Singers
Flip is guru Jiva Koolit; Freddie Johnson's girlfriend's away; three guys do jury duty and Rev. Leroy tries off-track betting.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E9 — Tim Conway, Burt Reynolds
Burt & Flip have a western shootout; Tim is the Pink Pirate; all do audience Q&A and Geraldine makes a movie with Burt.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E10 — Joan Rivers, Frank Gorshin, The Temptations
Joan does seated stand-up; a Godfather spoof shows off Gorshin’s many voices and The Temptations join Rev. Leroy’s church.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E11 — Dom DeLuise, Gladys Knight, Raymond Burr
Flip shows how to switch up a joke; the cast does wacky soap opera; Q&A with Raymond who also visits Charley’s Diner.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E1 — Muhammad Ali
Former heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali is interviewed.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E2 — Mandrill/LaBelle
Mrs. Georgia Jackson, mother of slain Soledad Brother George Jackson, is interviewed by producer- Ellis Haizlip.  Other show features include the exciting Latin-jazz sounds of  seven man combo.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E20 — A Friend in Need
Jerry dresses up like a clown and takes Webster to the leukemia ward at the children's hospital, where he makes a new friend and realizes how lucky he is to be healthy.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E21 — Almost Home
Webster's Uncle Jack has Webster visit him. Uncle Jack runs a foster home with a woman, but a conflict may force him to quit the home.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E22 — Farewell to Arms
Webster asks permission to buy a BB gun and he resorts to responsibility to get one. After getting one, and practicing with his friends, he accidentally kills a bird. This bird has babies and he takes the responsibility of raising them on his own.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E27 — My Family's Honor
Webster and Katherine both end up cheating on some school-related projects at the same time.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E29 — Rear View Mirror (Part 2)
As they continue to reminisce, Webster, Papa Papadapolis, and Jerry receive news that George and Katherine have both survived the hurricane.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E8 — Greek To Me
Tia faces a tough choice among competing sororities; while Jordan also learns a lesson about the Greek.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E9 — My Father's House
Jordan confronts his fears when Tamera and friends convince him that love is a two-way street.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E10 — For The People
Ray is frustrated that his political campaign is not allowing him the time to get to the heart of the issues with his constituents. His campaign manager has been driving Ray hard, and the results are starting to make an impact.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E11 — Twins Or Consequences
Tia gets cold feet after agreeing to take an exam for her twin sister.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E12 — Mixed Doubles
It's a game of musical dates as the girls' family and friends switch partners for a night on the town.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E9 — A Concerted Effort (Part 1)
Mo cries the lovesick blues on a phone-in radio show.  The DJ, feeling sorry for Mo, gives her four free tickets to an upcoming concert.
